title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: Leroy et al. (2021), PHANGS-ALMA, ApJS 257, 43, table of galaxies (orientations from Lang et al. 2020), row NGC0628: inclination 8.9 ± 12.2°, position angle 20.7 ± 1.0°. Which edge of the disc is nearer is not in the source: the disc is drawn with the edge at position angle 111° nearer, an assumption.

displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane, the disc's midplane, as the Milky Way's backing image does. Nothing in the image has depth.
coverage: Stars are removed from the picture before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it; 13 of the 13 Gaia stars brighter than G 14 in the picture had a glow, filled out to at most 124 px (39″).

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.264 degrees wide, tangent projection on 24.174166, +15.783458, north up; no crop or resample.
